description: This file defines the `PayGradeService` class in the `OrangeHRM` system, responsible for handling operations related to pay grades, currencies, and pay periods. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting pay grade data, as well as related currencies and filters, acting as a service layer interfacing with data access objects and normalization utilities.

classes.name: PayGradeService
classes.description: Service class providing operations for managing pay grades, currencies, and pay periods, acting as an intermediary between controllers and data access layers.

methods.name: getPayGradeDao
methods.description: Returns the current instance of PayGradeDao, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: setPayGradeDao
methods.description: Sets the PayGradeDao instance for this service.

methods.name: getPayGradeById
methods.description: Retrieves a PayGrade entity by its ID.

methods.name: getPayGradeList
methods.description: Returns a list of pay grades, optionally filtered by search parameters.

methods.name: getCurrencyListByPayGradeId
methods.description: Retrieves list of currency entries associated with a specific pay grade.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyList
methods.description: Returns a list of pay grade currency entities based on search filters.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of pay grade currencies matching the search filters.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCurrencyIdAndPayGradeId
methods.description: Fetches a specific PayGradeCurrency entry based on currency and pay grade IDs.

methods.name: isValidSalaryAmountForPayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Validates if a salary amount is within the min and max salary range of a specific PayGradeCurrency.

methods.name: getPayPeriodArray
methods.description: Returns an array of pay periods, normalized for external use.

methods.name: getPayGradeArray
methods.description: Returns an array of pay grades, normalized for external use.

methods.name: getCurrencyArray
methods.description: Returns an array of available currencies, normalized for external use.

methods.name: getCurrencyById
methods.description: Retrieves a CurrencyType entity by its ID.

methods.name: savePayGrade
methods.description: Persists a PayGrade entity to the database.

methods.name: deletePayGrades
methods.description: Deletes multiple pay grades by IDs.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves allowed pay currencies based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrenciesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of allowed pay currencies based on filter parameters.

methods.name: deletePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Deletes specific pay grade currency entries based on provided IDs.
